changeSet.author: stone-shelter
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE stone_document_index ( document_key varchar(120) PRIMARY KEY, source_version varchar(64), embedding_profile varchar(512), language varchar(8), indexed_fragments integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (indexed_fragments >= 0), active_operation_key uuid, owner_token uuid, UNIQUE (document_key, source_version), CHECK (source_version IS NULL OR source_version ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'), CHECK ((active_operation_key IS NULL) = (owner_token IS NULL)), CHECK ((source_version IS NULL AND embedding_profile IS NULL AND language IS NULL AND indexed_fragments = 0) OR (source_version IS NOT NULL AND embedding_profile IS NOT NULL AND language = 'en' AND indexed_fragments > 0)) ); CREATE TABLE stone_document_index_operation ( idempotency_key uuid PRIMARY KEY, document_key varchar(120) NOT NULL REFERENCES stone_document_index(document_key), kind varchar(12) NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('IMPORT', 'DELETE')), state varchar(12) NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('RUNNING', 'SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'EXPIRED')), owner_token uuid, deadline timestamptz, started_at timestamptz NOT NULL, committed_at timestamptz, replay_until timestamptz, source_version varchar(64), indexed_fragments integer CHECK (indexed_fragments > 0), outcome varchar(12) CHECK (outcome IN ('CREATED', 'REPLACED')), CHECK (state <> 'RUNNING' OR (owner_token IS NOT NULL AND deadline IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (state <> 'SUCCEEDED' OR (committed_at IS NOT NULL AND replay_until IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (state <> 'SUCCEEDED' OR kind <> 'IMPORT' OR (source_version IS NOT NULL AND indexed_fragments IS NOT NULL AND outcome IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (source_version IS NULL OR source_version ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') ); ALTER TABLE stone_document_index ADD CONSTRAINT stone_document_active_operation_fk FOREIGN KEY (active_operation_key) REFERENCES stone_document_index_operation(idempotency_key); CREATE TABLE stone_document_fragment ( document_key varchar(120) NOT NULL, fragment_order integer NOT NULL CHECK (fragment_order >= 0), source_version varchar(64) NOT NULL, embedding_profile varchar(512) NOT NULL, language varchar(8) NOT NULL CHECK (language = 'en'), stone_type varchar(24), section_path text NOT NULL, passage_text text NOT NULL, embedding vector(1024) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (document_key, fragment_order), FOREIGN KEY (document_key, source_version) REFERENCES stone_document_index(document_key, source_version), CHECK (stone_type IS NULL OR stone_type IN ('BASALT','GRANITE','OBSIDIAN','PUMICE','LIMESTONE','SANDSTONE','SHALE','MARBLE','GNEISS','SLATE')) );
